card.name: Start of 'Prescribing' in cross-references
card.fires_on: Most strongly on 'Pres' just before 'cribing Information' in 'See full Prescribing Information' style cross-references. Also fires on scattered linking words and punctuation, such as commas in lists of place names.

modes.label: Pres in Prescribing Information
modes.description: The first piece of 'Prescribing' when a label refers the reader to another product's prescribing information.
modes.example: See the flumazenil injection<< Pres>>cribing Information.

modes.label: Scattered joining words
modes.description: A comma, 'the' or 'in' in running prose, in both drug text and news text.
modes.example: one of<< the>> active ingredients in Umeclidinium and
